checks: blank and secret-key configs never send requests
state validator excludes free text, invalid dates, counters and oversized payloads
login exposes no tokens, preserves local progress, and requires pull before write
pull and compare-and-swap push send the remembered revision
conflicting device write remains visible and can be retried after pull
parallel pulls share one refresh-token exchange
logout clears local credentials even when remote revocation fails
late pull response cannot install a revision after signout
email signup requires confirmation when server returns no session
restored session is verified before progress is read
invalid restored session is removed without deleting exercise data
GitHub PKCE uses SHA-256, persists verifier only in sessionStorage, then exchanges callback
unsolicited OAuth code or implicit tokens cannot establish a session
failed PKCE exchange clears one-use verifier and leaves local progress intact
a wrong answer does not award points; a corrected mistake stays in review until retrained
merge preserves offline completions and resolves review by time without doubling attempts
grading requires the exact evidence set and rejects ambiguous numeric strings
imports filter unknown IDs and prototype keys instead of allowing arbitrary progress
unlock and streak reflect completed practice, including yesterday and missed days
optional Python never blocks AI or reporting and is skipped by Continue without awarding completion
a stale second tab merges the latest local snapshot before writing
storage events recover simultaneous tab writes and settle without a write loop
account changes restore the correct namespace and invalidate late operations even for the same account
drafts survive progress merges, stay outside exports, and clear on account changes
a blocked storage write preserves in-memory practice and reports the failure

dom_checks.method: Temporary JSDOM harness evaluated app.js with actual progress modules and lesson data; the cloud adapter was substituted with controlled promises and synthetic account events.
checks: delayed account verification and remote merge retain checkbox drafts and repaint XP
numeric draft and text selection survive cloud repaint
offline restored account is labelled unverified and failed logout immediately restores guest namespace
cancelled OAuth produces a visible account notice
late account-A sync cannot alter guest or account-B after logout
Python is optional in both Continue and the exercise skip action
storage event merges another tab completion without deleting the selected answer
fresh review and completed-unit replay clear old answers while unfinished navigation retains drafts

regression_followup.trigger: Answer profiles-1 incorrectly, then correctly; finish the unit and open Review.

limitations: DOM checks used JSDOM, not a real browser or a visual rendering engine.
Cloud responses and auth events were simulated; these checks do not establish live OAuth, Supabase availability, RLS, or actual cross-device synchronization.
Mobile layout, assistive technologies, and live browser storage behavior need separate browser verification.
The temporary DOM harness is not included in the repository; only its observed results are persisted here. A maintained browser regression suite remains future work.
